task_specification.objective: Advance release convergence with one ordinary product task that makes the five-wave run, onboarding persistence, spatial/camera/input contracts, and truthful choice presentation directly retestable, plus one isolated dense-performance instrumentation task that preserves explicit software-renderer qualification limits.

diagnosis.root_cause: The ordinary route still depends on accelerated or fixture-only terminal branches, and Retry reconstructs first-run guidance instead of preserving session completion. Dense profiling correctly rejects llvmpipe but lacks a sufficiently bounded, renderer-aware qualification path for later native recapture. Required player-facing spatial, camera/input, and choice-hierarchy capabilities also need one integrated release pass.

stop_conditions: Do not assign or claim closure for the deferred cemetery-camera finding; implement only the mandatory current-loop spatial/camera capability without using that issue id.
Do not replace the retained authored cemetery or character packages, add procedural map fills, or turn either task into unrelated asset work.
Do not claim native 1920x1080 performance from llvmpipe; stop at explicit rejected/unqualified status when native hardware is unavailable.
Do not use accelerated victory/failure fixtures as evidence of an ordinary successful five-wave route.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy from prior tuning: repair the authoritative run/session state and real director transitions, while separately hardening bounded telemetry and renderer classification. Keep mandatory spatial, input, and choice presentation behavior in the ordinary product task so dense qualification cannot displace player-visible work.

code: Run bounded Godot static/script checks for run_controller, wave_director, onboarding/input routing, spatial/navigation, upgrade-draft UI, and dense_profile changes.
Run preservation checks for host_godot_boot and native_godot_project after implementation.
Verify dense instrumentation flag-off behavior has no authoritative-state or gameplay-timing delta and that profile buffers/logging remain bounded.
runtime: Tester recaptures title→ordinary gameplay→five waves→Bellkeeper→Result→Retry and verifies the same-session onboarding, clean reset, and authoritative receipts.

Tester performs ordinary movement replay across the expanded arena, central landmark and perimeter visibility/collision checks, min/default/max zoom through mouse-wheel and gamepad with modal isolation, three recovered Dash attempts across pause/damage/death/Retry/title, and blocked-route enemy recovery.
Tester opens the upgrade draft and verifies icon/silhouette hierarchy, truthful current-to-new deltas, no placeholder CURRENT values, and keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus and debounced confirmation.

Tester runs dense_prepare→dense_advance→dense_reset repeatedly, inspects bounded samples and renderer metadata, and on eligible native hardware repeats at 1920x1080; llvmpipe evidence remains explicitly unqualified.
visual: Inspect ordinary combat at shipped camera scale for readable enemy occupancy, projectile/telegraph separation, central landmark and external-world continuity, and no disappearance or occlusion drift.
Inspect Result, Retry, onboarding, and upgrade-draft pages at native/fullscreen/windowed supported UI scales for readable hierarchy, focus states, and no debug-like text stacking.
Confirm dense instrumentation produces no visible debug artifacts or HUD clutter.

done_when: A black-box ordinary run advances through authored waves 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 in order, including composition escalation, an elite encounter, Bellkeeper transition, and exactly one terminal Result state without an accelerated-only shortcut.

The authoritative run snapshot/director records current wave, phase, spawn budget/live cap, boss state, victory/failure, and Result transition; no spawning, damage, rewards, timers, or audio continue after terminal state.

After guidance_help dismisses first-run teaching, Retry starts clean gameplay without replaying the guidance in the same session; title return has explicit reset semantics. Guidance remains short, dismissible, live-bound to the InputMap/device, and leaves gameplay unpaused.

The arena has larger traversable scale with a coherent external world/external depth, and the central building/landmark plus perimeter/boundary remain visible and aligned under ordinary movement/movement replay; authored geometry agrees with collision and no landmark disappearance or camera occlusion drift occurs.

Ordinary enemies remain legible relative to the player at the shipped camera. Mouse-wheel and gamepad zoom expose clamped minimum, default, and maximum bounds; modal UI isolates zoom input. Dash accepts a new ordinary input after cooldown and remains repeatable across pause, damage, death, Retry, and title return.
Enemy navigation keeps actors outside authored coffins, gravestones, walls, and buildings using collision-aware movement and a visible blocked-route recovery path.

The upgrade/weapon choice page leads with distinct silhouettes or authored icons, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant deltas, no placeholder CURRENT values, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus/hover/pressed states without prose stacking or clipping.

Tester has direct same-session black-box and authoritative white-box retest paths for both active issues, plus spatial, camera/dash, obstacle, and choice screenshots/state receipts; bounded code checks pass.

Update the real upgrade-draft scene/controller so every offered choice communicates identity and truthful deltas through visual hierarchy and all input focus states. Instrumentation is flag/config gated, uses bounded buffers and allocation/log limits, and has no gameplay-timing, spawn, targeting, HUD, or audio-presentation side effects when disabled.

QA can recapture the profile on eligible native hardware at 1920x1080 and distinguish candidate regressions from an unavailable renderer; touched modules pass static/code checks and host_godot_boot/native_godot_project behavior remains intact.
